setName: 2025 Topps Chrome Update Series Baseball -- named insert/autograph sets
mintedBy: Diagnosed against a read-only sold_comps sample (baseball/2025/topps-chrome, 300-sale sample): 25 distinct ids point-read genuinely absent. Most (USC*, USA-*) are a WRONG-KEY defect -- sales are landing under bare topps-chrome instead of the already-registered, already-partially-backed topps-chrome-update-series (confirmed: hiq:baseball:2025:topps-chrome-update-series:usc145:base:no-auto FOUND, blue-wave-refractor NOT FOUND -- a real ladder gap under the correct key, not sourced this package, flagged for a follow-up). The remaining genuine gaps named 5 insert/autograph sets by cardNumber prefix -- AC (Chrome Update Autographs), CRDA (Rookie Debut Autographs), CHRU (Chromeography), CLA (Chrome Legends Autographs), NT (Night Terrors) -- all found on checklistinsider.com's 2025 Topps Chrome Update Series product page (NOT the base 2025 Topps Chrome page, which does not carry these codes).

breakerOnlyUnnumberedRungs.reason: An unnumbered, distribution-restricted (Breaker-format-only) rung listed alongside the numbered ladder on both AC and CRDA. Held out to match this package's convention of only minting rungs with a stated print run or a clean base/no-print-run shape, consistent with the repo's existing doctrine that a distribution note (Hobby/Retail/Breaker-only) is not itself a roster restriction but an unnumbered NAMED variant needs its own explicit confirmation before minting -- deferred to keep this package's scope tight, not because it is doubted.

raContinuationOfChromeUpdateAutographs.reason: 17-card RA- continuation of the 127-card Chrome Update Autographs set, immediately following AC- with no section boundary. Out of this task's target prefix scope (nt-, cla-, ac-, crda-, chru-); not independently roster-verified.

uscUsaBaseLadderGap.reason: The USC/USA-prefixed base numbered cards (e.g. USC145, USA-KC) already have a blank-parallel base row staged under the correct topps-chrome-update-series key (confirmed: hiq:baseball:2025:topps-chrome-update-series:usc145:base:no-auto FOUND) but are missing several colour rungs (blue-wave-refractor, aqua-refractor, etc.) -- this is the BASE ladder for the product, not a named insert, and is out of scope for this insert-focused package. Flagged as a follow-up candidate.

spellingAudit: category names follow the established convention; no duplicate-spelling collisions found against the repo's existing Topps Chrome packages (checked: no prior 2025 topps-chrome-update-series base or insert package exists in the repo to collide with).

isAutoConsistencyCheck: Every row for a given cardNumber prefix carries the SAME isAuto value (AC-/CRDA-/CHRU-/CLA- all true; NT- all false).
